name: Probiotic Combination [2.3 Billion]
indication_description: It is indicated for vaginal irritation, vaginal discomfort, reduction of colonization of bad bacteria & yeast in the vagina. pH protection of vagina against imbalances. Re-establishment & maintenance of good bacteria in the vagina. It is also indicated for urinary tract infection.
pharmacology_description: A combination of Lactobacillus rhamnosus GR-1 and Lactobacillus reuteri RC-14 has been associated with support of the female urogenital tracts of teens, premenopausal and post menopausal women.
dosage_description: Take 1 to 2 capsules with food, preferably with breakfast daily. Or, as directed by the registered physician.
interaction_description: No clinically significant drug interaction has been reported.
contraindications_description: This capsule is contraindicated with known hypersensitivity to any component of the formulation.
side_effects_description: No clinically significant adverse reactions have been observed in therapeutic dosage. Probiotics are likely safe for most people.
pregnancy_and_lactation_description: It is safe to use during pregnancy and lactation.
storage_conditions_description: Keep out of reach of the children. Keep away from direct sunlight. Store below 30°C in a dry place.
